versions.name: Champions for Nature Tiger

provenance.notes: Name, rank placement and category from the official rank adventure pages. The evergreen description is original prose regenerated from the adventure's own 'Snapshot' section, excluding requirement text.

versions.description: Tigers join a worldwide Scouting effort to care for natural resources. They tell renewable resources from non-renewable ones, explore reducing, reusing, and recycling, and pitch in on a hands-on conservation project.
